Definition: adverb from G1103; genuinely, i.e. really:--naturally.
BiblicalUsage: gnēsíōs is a plain word for naturally. In Philippians 2:20, the text says "who will naturally care for your state."
TheologicalSignificance: I read gnēsíōs plainly — it means naturally, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
